rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing cakraṃ
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, possessing a pericarp

items.question: What are the defining characteristics attributed to the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the subject.
It is described as royal in nature.
It is characterized as eight-petaled and possessing a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is defined as a royal, eight-petaled wheel with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The specific name or location of this sixth cakra is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, eight-petaled, and has a pericarp.
